title: How AI agents negotiate prices autonomously

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: What if AI agents could negotiate prices in real time, without human intervention? How would that reshape commerce?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Current systems use reinforcement learning and game theory to simulate negotiations, but real-world unpredictability still limits autonomy.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: Autonomous price negotiation risks deepening economic inequality, especially if AI favors corporate interests over consumer welfare.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Engineers are embedding fairness constraints and transparency layers to ensure negotiations remain equitable and auditable.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: In the future, AI could enable dynamic, fair pricing that adapts to local needs, empowering small businesses globally.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future of commerce may lie in AI-driven negotiations that balance efficiency, ethics, and human values.

video_cue: A digital marketplace interface showing AI agents negotiating prices in real time with clear, transparent data flows.
